ache.title: 36 stars, and then the next shiny thing
ache.note: Past-Nero brags about 36 stars in the Spiral Abyss, then says he’s just ‘casually’ playing new characters and events. Casual is how it starts: the Abyss resets, events rotate, and a finished goal quietly becomes a new one. He’s in no rush for the story. The new characters, though? Those he keeps up with.
watch: Abyss stars: a goal that resets
events that rotate on a timer
ache.tip: When you finish a goal, let it stay finished. Take the win and close the game for a day.
lines: a finished goal is allowed to stay finished

title: Genshin Impact - Main Events
excerpt: There has been a time in which I played Genshin a whole lot, exploring its mechanics and challenges, with getting 36 stars in the Abyss being my main challenge. Now that I have achieved that, what I'm most interested in is just casually playing new characters and events. The story is also good, but I'm not in a rush to complete it.
